avis.titre: Does what it says and didn't break me out!
avis.texte: I've had a hard time finding a quality moisturizer that doesn't have a single comedogenic ingredient. This is gentle, hydrating and light enough to wear under makeup. I think my only complaint is it feels more like a day cream. Not as rough as I'd like for a night cream, but again I don't see any dry patches or feel like my face is lacking moisture.

avis.titre: My favorite product from Korea- now available here!
avis.texte: I literally brought three of these back from Korea because I was so obsessed with this product and thought I'd never see them again - and now it is for sale at Ulta!!! Truly an amazing moisturizer, and a great price.
